zh: 只能删最左元素，所以最后留下的一定是原数组的某个后缀，问题变成找最长的元素互异后缀。
从右往左逐个把值加入集合，第一次遇到已经见过的值时，这个位置及其左边都不能保留。
i 从 n−1 递减，若 a[i] 已在集合中，答案为 i+1（0 基下标）并结束；否则把 a[i] 加入集合；扫完都没有重复则输出 0。
en: Only the leftmost element can be deleted, so what remains is always a suffix of the original array, and the task is to find the longest suffix with distinct elements.
Add values to a set from right to left; the first time a value has already been seen, that position and everything to its left cannot be kept.
Go from i=n-1 down; if a[i] is already in the set, the answer is i+1 (with 0-based i) and you stop; otherwise insert a[i]; if no repeat appears, output 0.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Add values to a set from right to left; at the first position i whose value has already been seen, everything up to it must be deleted, so the answer is i+1; if there is never a repeat, the answer is 0.

## Proof of correctness

At the first repeat met from the right, positions i+1..end are already distinct and can be kept. Any suffix starting at or before i contains a[i] and a later position with the same value, so it is invalid; hence at least i+1 items must be deleted, and this attains the minimum.

## Complexity

Time O(n), space O(n).
